label: Re-review of libs/data/vectors/vector-store — 4 issues check

findings.description: ISSUE 1 — SpaceInvariantError: FIXED. SqliteVectorBackend.upsert() now throws SpaceInvariantError (not generic Error) when vec.length !== space.dim. Test at spec.ts:152-165 verifies type, nodeId, space, and actualDim.

ISSUE 1 (LanceDb) — SpaceInvariantError: FIXED. LanceDbVectorBackend.upsert() also throws SpaceInvariantError (imported from index.ts) on dim mismatch. Note: InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() at lancedb.ts:45 still throws generic Error, but the code path is unreachable since LanceDbVectorBackend.upsert() validates first.
findings.fix_sketch: Already resolved for the public API. InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() is a private internal class; its generic Error is a minor style concern, not a bug.

findings.description: ISSUE 2 — getTable() auto-creates spaces: FIXED. getTable() now throws Error('Space not found: ... — call ensureSpace() first') instead of silently creating the table. In index.ts, knn/get/iter all use tableExists() guards and return []/null without auto-creation.
ISSUE 3 — openLanceDbVectorStore return type: FIXED. Return type is 'LanceDbVectorBackend & VectorBackend' as required.

ISSUE 4 — db param optional: PARTIALLY FIXED. The factory openLanceDbVectorStore requires db via 'config: LanceDbVectorBackendConfig & { db: Database.Database }'. However, the LanceDbVectorBackend constructor at lancedb.ts:99 still accepts db? (optional). The factory boundary enforces the requirement, but the constructor signature itself is not tightened.
findings.fix_sketch: Change LanceDbVectorBackend constructor parameter from '{ db?: Database.Database }' to '{ db: Database.Database }' at lancedb.ts:99 if db is truly required for the implementation. Otherwise, leave the factory-level enforcement as sufficient.

findings.description: NEW FINDING — Spec gap: ReembedOpts.getText missing from COMPILED_INTERFACES.md. The code defines getText?: (id: number) => string | null on ReembedOpts (line 348) and requires it for non-dry-run reembed (lines 423-433). The spec at COMPILED_INTERFACES.md lines 456-471 does not include getText in ReembedOpts. The spec comment 'walks vec.iter(sourceModelId) → provider.embedBatch()' is also misleading — embedBatch takes strings, not Float32Arrays, so getText is necessary to map vector IDs back to source text.
findings.fix_sketch: Add getText?: (id: number) => string | null to ReembedOpts in COMPILED_INTERFACES.md. Update the reembed() docstring to clarify the flow: 'walks vec.iter(sourceModelId) → getText() for each ID → provider.embedBatch() → vec.upsert(targetSpace)'.

findings.description: NEW FINDING — InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() throws generic Error instead of SpaceInvariantError. While the code path is unreachable (LanceDbVectorBackend.upsert() validates first), this internal implementation does not follow the '[def:space-invariant] — all implementations must enforce this' invariant pattern. For consistency and defense-in-depth, it should throw SpaceInvariantError.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace 'throw new Error(...)' with 'throw new SpaceInvariantError(id, { modelId: '', dim: this.dimension }, vec.length)' at lancedb.ts:45. Note: SpaceInvariantError takes 'space: VectorSpace' but InMemoryLanceTable doesn't have the modelId — either add it to the table or accept this as an internal implementation detail.

backlog_entries: ReembedOpts.getText is present in code but absent from the COMPILED_INTERFACES.md spec — update the spec to match implementation.
InMemoryLanceTable.upsert() at lancedb.ts:45 uses generic Error instead of SpaceInvariantError for dim mismatch (defense-in-depth path).
LanceDbVectorBackend constructor still accepts db? optional at lancedb.ts:99, though the factory openLanceDbVectorStore requires it.
